x: Memories of Brighton Walks with Tommy Green, Fred Rickards and Fred Bentley to the fore, followed by many other stalwarts; of National 20-Miles Championships with George Cooper, Bob McMullen (Senior), Stanley Manning.
These include Stan Manning, Alec Spendlove, Bert Foster, a one-time Blackstaffe Shield holder and a leader of the cross-country team before the Great War, and R.
Stan Manning, who was ill last year, is now recovering and hopes to get to Wimbledon during the winter. Jack Rutland informs us that he will soon be out training again with an eye to long distance.
A very good crowd of supporters accompanied the walkers and many Club members and friends were seen on the road including Stan Manning and Jim Chalk.
Stanley Manning of our walking teams of the 1920's and a one time holder of the Norwich to Ipswich record has been in ill-health lately but hopes to call in at Wimbledon during the Winter season.
